title: Prism
subtitle: 116 emerald-cut diamonds, each one chosen, each one placed — assembled into a surface that moves like water and catches light like a mirror.
description: The grid pattern is intentional. Emerald cuts stacked tight in a mosaic — large stones anchoring the center rows, smaller ones tiling the edges — creates a kind of diamond textile. From across the room it reads as light. Up close it reads as precision.
inquirySubject: Prism — The Emerald-Cut Bracelet ref. C0493
